title: Asymmetry of a class of Mellin transforms
summary: We consider a class of Mellin transforms $μ_η$ associated with a class of functions $η$, defined for every complex $s$ in the critical strip. We establish sufficient conditions on $η$ under which $μ_η(s)$ and $μ_η(1-s)$ cannot both vanish outside the critical line for sufficiently large imaginary parts of $s$. An application is given to the case in which $η$ is the fractional part function, for which the zeros of $μ_η$ coincide with the zeros of the Riemann zeta function.
